_comment: Acknowledged formula disagreements. The check fails on any disagreement not listed here or whose variants have changed, and on entries that are no longer in disagreement. Two separate operations maintain this file: `--prune-baseline` removes groups that have been resolved and refuses to run while a regression is present, and `--accept-new-debt --reason '...'` is the deliberate act of taking on a new or changed disagreement. Never edit this file by hand to silence a finding.
